Remark
[Ricci flow on closed surfaces] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0385 1. appD:D.8\group Ricci Flow Convergence

On every closed surface, the normalized Ricci flow exists globally and converges to a constant-curvature metric.
